network.domain: h in [-1,1]^16; componentwise absolute errors; real arithmetic; arbitrary x; no sampled Jacobian claim
network.full_feedback_storage: NOT_ESTABLISHED; observation/plant/caches/clock and joint residual need coupled domain bounds

capture.relation: same-phase capture: dp_target=dp_held; dv_target=alpha*dv_held,H; d(position input)=0; d(velocity input,H)=(1-alpha)*dv_held,H; memory unchanged
capture.speed_reference: b_a(v,t)=prox_(a*t*L2)(v); globally 1-Lipschitz; integral D is t-Lipschitz
capture.repair_parameter: if every allowed held |v_i|<=L, (1-alpha)*L+epsilon<=1 implies alpha>=1-(1-epsilon)/L; P12 actual alpha=1
capture.scope: whole target hold profile and capture jump; not body closed-loop safety or resume guarantee

filter.same_command_initial_memory: E(T)<=exp(-T/.025)*E0 for any same command sequence and branch crossings
filter.thrust_interface: |dT|<=2*k*Omega*|d(actual_scaled_joint)|; filter error alone does not bound actual joint error
filter.source_application: configured Gazebo FirstOrderFilter update; applies every physical dt, not controller/native ticks

A4_counterexample.reason: filter constraints restrict an execution subsystem, but A4 innovation lives in p/v/q; no certified causal plant/estimator residual relation excludes its 22-step sequence while covering all records
A4_counterexample.missing_first_interface: first physical/estimator transition after command selection: bounded causal joint, torque, cache and estimation residual, coupled to complete feedback

actual_record_coverage: P11#70 dual-clock legal word accepted; no future scheduler or whole plant coverage certificate
method_not_score: analytic componentwise hybrid incremental relations and repair constraints retained; empirical predictions are separate
